backend/main.mo: Motoko canister implementing RBAC, user profiles, invoice storage, and payment entry handling with validation and permission checks.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report referencing files, components, and tests for promoting the draft build to production.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Collection of prewritten summaries describing the purpose of each frontend source file.
frontend/docs/publish-live.md: Go‑live checklist covering authentication, core features, UI/UX, data integrity, compatibility, and post‑deployment smoke testing.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS config defining light/dark theme variables and global base styles.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point loading the React app root and main script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up TanStack Router, authentication gating, role‑based routing, layout, and profile‑setup modal handling.
frontend/src/components/auth/AccessDenie: UI screen shown when a user lacks permissions, providing a button to return home.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Modal requiring new users to save name and role, calling backend to store the profile.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Provides the main app layout with navigation, mobile menu, user info, and logout handling based on identity and role.
frontend/src/components/payments/Payment: Renders and manages a dynamic list of payment mode entries, supporting add, remove, and field updates.
frontend/src/components/reports/ReportsF: Displays filter controls for reports, including date, salesman, payment type, and payment mode, updating parent state on change.
frontend/src/components/reports/Retailer: Groups payment entries by retailer and renders a ledger-style table with amounts, dates, and payment details.
frontend/src/components/tables/InvoicesT: Shows a paginated invoices table with status badges and navigation actions for payment entry and history.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user's identity, refreshing dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUser.ts: Fetches the current user's profile and role using the actor and exposes loading and admin state.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and provider for Internet Identity authentication, exposing login state, identity, and helper methods.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching and mutating invoices, payments, and reports through the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Sets Tailwind base styles and theme variables for both light and dark modes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminDashboardP: Displays admin dashboard stats using reports data and provides navigation to management pages.
frontend/src/pages/admin/RawDataUploadPa: Allows admins to upload invoice files, filter existing invoices, and view them in a table.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Renders the login UI and triggers Internet Identity authentication.
frontend/src/pages/payments/EditPaymentE: Page for editing an existing payment, loading its data, allowing updates to amount and mode, and submitting changes.
frontend/src/pages/payments/PaymentEntry: Page for creating new payments for an invoice, validating multiple payment lines, and submitting them to the backend.
frontend/src/pages/payments/PaymentHisto: Displays a retailer’s payment history with formatted details and admin edit actions.
frontend/src/pages/reports/ReportsPage.t: Shows reports with filters, summary stats, ledger table, and CSV export functionality.
frontend/src/types/payment.ts: Defines the PaymentLine interface representing a single entered payment row.
frontend/src/utils/excel/parseInvoicesXl: Parses CSV-like XLSX uploads into Invoice objects, validating required columns and values.
frontend/src/utils/export/exportReportsT: Generates a downloadable CSV report containing payment summaries and details.
frontend/src/utils/filtering/invoiceFilt: Provides filtering logic for invoices based on retailer info, invoice number, and salesman.
frontend/src/utils/payments/paymentStatu: Computes total, remaining, and excess payment amounts and determines payment status based on totals.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers for reading URL parameters, persisting them in sessionStorage, and managing hash-based params.
frontend/src/utils/validation/paymentEnt: Validates payment entries by checking payment type, positive amounts, and required fields for each payment mode.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending colors, fonts, layout, animations, and enabling plugins like typography and container queries.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing features, architecture notes, known issues, and overall app objectives for a payment tracking system.
